info.title: zubairaziz.dev API
info.description: Read-only endpoints describing Zubair Aziz's personal site.

x-webmcp-tools.name: get_resume
x-webmcp-tools.summary: Read the current resume as JSON.

x-webmcp-tools.name: set_resume
x-webmcp-tools.summary: Replace the resume with a complete new object.

get.description: Returns profile metadata about Zubair Aziz.

A browser-based resume builder. The page registers WebMCP tools — get_resume, set_resume, clear_resume — so an AI agent with WebMCP support can read and fill the form. These tools are client-side and are not callable over this HTTP API.
